items.title: This year set to be one of four hottest on record, UN report says
items.summary: GENEVA, Nov 9 (Reuters) - This year is on track to be one of the four hottest on record, driven by a powerful ElNiño and perpetuating a warming streak of more than a decade, a UNreport showed on Monday. • Countries are preparing tomeet in Turkey ​from November 9 to 20 for the next round of climate talks and the World Meteorological Organization "State of the Climate"report provides the latest available data to inform their discussions.

ai.sum: A UN report says 2026 is on track to be one of the four hottest years on record, ahead of COP31 talks in Turkey.
